story: Discovered in 1852 by Italian astronomer Annibale de Gasparis, 16 Psyche is a giant M-type asteroid orbiting in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter. Spanning a mean diameter of about 222 kilometers, Psyche contains roughly one percent of the cumulative mass of the entire asteroid belt. Long hypothesized to be the exposed metallic core of a destroyed protoplanet, recent models and mass estimates have cast some doubt on this origin story. Nevertheless, Psyche's high bulk density and radar observations reveal a surface rich in metal phases and silicate minerals. To explore this mysterious world, NASA launched a spacecraft named after the asteroid on October 13, 2023, aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, with an expected arrival in 2029 to conduct the first-ever exploration of a metallic asteroid.
angle: NASA is journeying to 16 Psyche, a giant floating metal world in the asteroid belt that may be the exposed core of an ancient destroyed protoplanet.

claims.claim: It was discovered by Italian astronomer Annibale de Gasparis.
Psyche's semi-major axis or average orbital distance is 2.92 AU.
Psyche orbits the Sun once every approximately 5 years.

disputed: Whether Psyche is truly the exposed core of a differentiated protoplanet or formed through re-accretion or iron volcanism remains uncertain and debated, and a script should attribute these ideas as hypotheses.
